name: ProjectSnapshot chat evidence acquisition orchestration
purpose: Make bounded ProjectSnapshot acquisition a first-class continuation of ordinary 1C skill work when current evidence is insufficient.

availability_guard.rule: Collector-specific transitions, chat responsibilities, developer steps and definition-of-done clauses apply only when the repository-pinned manifest/payload are present and the integrity path succeeds. If the active distribution intentionally omits the Collector or integrity prerequisites are unavailable, do not synthesize/build it; use the existing COLLECTOR_UNAVAILABLE bounded manual fallback.

required_conditions: a material active 1C claim remains evidence-required or runtime-pending after inspecting already supplied/authorized evidence
the missing evidence can be expressed as exact item/category/logical-target rows
at least one backend actually available in the customer contour can acquire useful evidence
ProjectSnapshot is a smaller deterministic acquisition path than broad/manual source hunting
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run the collector when existing evidence already closes the claim
do not request a whole configuration merely because one supported bounded item is missing
do not route an unsupported source-target shape to a different source item and call it equivalent
do not ask an ordinary developer to rebuild ProjectSnapshotCollector.epf when a READY repository artifact exists

requires: planner run against actually available backends
READY repository collector payload retrieved and integrity-verified
chat materializes ProjectSnapshotCollector.epf for the developer alongside the plan
developer opens the chat-provided ProjectSnapshotCollector.epf in intended infobase

transitions.effect: no package observation may be used as proof

transitions.when: binding succeeds but at least one requested item is failed/unsupported/insufficient/unavailable
binding succeeds and requested automatic evidence is returned at required acquisition status
one or more usable SOURCE_EXPORT items are present
requires: match source_file/path/content to exact requested item
match source_file/path/content to exact requested item

transitions.when: usable runtime-only evidence has been accepted or source inspection is complete for usable source items

requires: failed or insufficient items remain unresolved

transitions.when: analysis discovers a new material dependency not covered by accepted evidence
transitions.effect: request only newly required items for the same applicable baseline; reuse the same verified EPF unless its distribution identity changed

transitions.when: current evidence gap is sufficiently resolved
transitions.effect: resume original requirements/review/design/implementation point without asking user to restate it

chat_responsibilities: re-evaluate ProjectSnapshot immediately after a discovery bootstrap source inventory
split supported exact collector evidence from unsupported manual fallback instead of replacing the whole gap with a broad manual request
resolve ProjectSnapshot disposition before every manual current-1C source request
verify collector artifact manifest, payload Git blob identities, reconstructed binary SHA-256/size/blob identity and build-input Git blob binding before delivery
materialize and provide ProjectSnapshotCollector.epf to the developer when collection is required
generate plan file when artifact creation is available
provide collector and plan together instead of making the developer build or locate the collector
explain only minimal collector/run steps required by the developer
recognize returned ProjectSnapshot evidence package automatically
validate package with expected active request_id
inspect concrete SOURCE_EXPORT bytes before closing source claims
reuse valid partial evidence and preserve unresolved items
issue delta plan instead of broad repeat collection
developer_responsibilities: open the ProjectSnapshotCollector.epf provided by chat in intended infobase
enter Designer credentials locally when needed
load the CollectionPlan provided by chat
developer_must_not_be_required_to: clone the skill repository merely to obtain the collector
keep a local collector copy between unrelated tasks
understand or reconstruct repository payload encoding
extract individual modules from a valid package
repeat original task context after package upload
manually locate or export an exact current-1C module that the active ProjectSnapshot plan can collect
repeat a broad current-1C source export merely because ProjectSnapshot was not dispositioned
proof_boundaries: repository payload present != reconstructed binary integrity accepted
collector binary integrity accepted != customer package proof
source bytes inspected != deployed runtime behavior
runtime item observation proves only its exact bound item at observed fidelity
collector implementation acceptance never promotes unrelated claims
privacy_and_security: exclude runtime business data by default
Designer credentials are local inputs and not evidence-package fields
never accept an unverified/stale repository payload merely because the target filename matches
definition_of_done: verified current ProjectSnapshotCollector.epf and exact CollectionPlan are provided when collection is required
package is bound or explicitly rejected
every requested item has an explicit disposition
required returned source bytes are inspected and matched
usable evidence is incorporated into the original task
original task is resumed or smallest delta request is issued

rules: a broad audit or review is not by itself a reason to bypass ProjectSnapshot
when an exact supported item is missing and no independently required discovery artifact already subsumes it, ProjectSnapshot must be used instead of requesting that same evidence manually

when supported and unsupported gaps coexist, ProjectSnapshot collects the supported exact portion and manual acquisition is limited to the unsupported remainder unless one independently required discovery artifact already subsumes both

DISCOVERY_BOOTSTRAP is allowed only when exact target identities must first be discovered or a broad source artifact is independently required for unsupported form extension or changed-object inventory
after DISCOVERY_BOOTSTRAP is inventoried the gate must be re-run before any further current-1C evidence request
do not duplicate acquisition when supplied or bootstrap source already closes the supported claim
manual fallback must retain a concrete reason and must not imply that ProjectSnapshot is unavailable when it was merely deferred
pre_manual_current_onec_gate.user_facing_policy: do not expose internal disposition labels unless they materially clarify why a manual artifact is still required
